en.headline: Chiikawa-themed Light Rail makes its last weekend trips today
en.dek: Special trains have run four trips each Saturday and Sunday from Siu Hong since 25 July; an $88 same-day Light Rail pass is sold at that stop.
body: Sunday is the last operating day of MTR's Chiikawa-themed Light Rail, which has run on weekends since 25 July as part of the Next Station: Chiikawa Artiverse campaign.

The corporation said the decorated trains make four trips each Saturday and Sunday from Siu Hong Stop towards Tuen Mun or Yuen Long, following former Light Rail Voyager routes. Passengers who buy an $88 Light Rail Travel Pass at Siu Hong on the day may take one ride on the themed service in a designated timeslot and travel unlimited on other Light Rail routes that day.

The related Chiikawa Artiverse exhibition continues at K11 MUSEA and the Tsim Sha Tsui waterfront until 6 September, organised by AllRightsReserved with Spiralcute International. Indoor galleries are on the sixth floor; a 16-seat Chiikawa-Go-Round installation is on the ground-floor promenade.

zh.headline: Chiikawa主題輕鐵今日最後一個周末行走
zh.dek: 由7月25日起逢周六日由兆康開出四班特色列車，當日於該站可買88元全日輕鐵乘車證。
body: 港鐵「下一站：CHIIKAWA ARTIVERSE」主題輕鐵周日為最後一個營運日，特色列車自7月25日起只在周末行走。
港鐵表示，列車逢周六日由兆康站開出四班，分別前往屯門或元朗，行走昔日輕鐵觀光路線。乘客當日在兆康站購買88元「輕鐵乘車證」，可於指定時段乘坐一程主題列車，並於當日無限次乘搭其他輕鐵路線。
相關「CHIIKAWA ARTIVERSE」特展則繼續於尖沙咎K11 MUSEA及海濱舉行至9月6日，由AllRightsReserved主辦、Spiralcute International特別合作。室內展區設於6樓，地下海濱長廊則設有16個座位的Chiikawa迴旋木馬裝置。
